answer.answer: According to the AI Risk Management Framework, accuracy measurements must always be paired with clearly defined and realistic test sets that represent conditions of expected use, along with details regarding the test methodology. These items must also be included in the associated documentation.

citations.quote: Accuracy measurements should always be paired with clearly defined and realistic test sets – that are representative of conditions of expected use – and details about test methodology; these should be included in associated documen- tation.
citations.source: National Institute of Standards and Technology (NIST AI 100-1, January 2023)
